import sys

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])

import notify

outbox = []
ada = {"name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com", "referrer": "Grace"}
bob = {"name": "Bob", "email": "bob@example.com"}
order = {"id": "A-17", "items": [{"name": "towel", "price": 12.5}, {"name": "soap", "price": 3.25}]}
print(notify.send_welcome(ada, outbox))
print(notify.send_welcome(bob, outbox))
print(notify.send_receipt(bob, order, outbox))
print(notify.send_receipt(ada, {"id": "A-18", "items": []}, outbox))
for message in outbox:
    print(message)
try:
    notify.send_welcome({"name": "NoMail"}, outbox)
except KeyError as exc:
    print("KeyError", exc, len(outbox))
print("ok")
